name: None (cut)
use_when: Dense data decks or rapid step-throughs where any motion is a distraction

name: Fade
use_when: The calm default — most decks; understated and on-brand

name: Slide
use_when: A linear narrative where forward/back direction should read as motion
motion: full-width horizontal slide in the nav direction

name: Push up
direction_aware: full-height vertical push in the nav direction

name: Slide + fade
use_when: A soft directional cue without a full hard slide
motion: short slide (60px) combined with opacity fade

name: Zoom
direction_aware: incoming scales down from 1.06 while fading in

name: Zoom out
use_when: Returning to an overview or wrapping a section
motion: incoming scales up from 0.92 while fading in

name: Reveal (wipe)
use_when: A dramatic chapter change; the new slide wipes across the old
motion: clip-path wipe from the nav-direction edge
